subject: Stan Math and its dependent libraries

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Stan Math and its dependent libraries
parts:
Right now, the Stan Math library is assumed to live at the same level as the other libraries for Stan. It currently doesn't have any of its dependent libraries. We could add its dependent libraries, but then we might want to remove the libraries out of Stan if we do.


Currently:
- If Math is cloned from Stan, running the tests from Math work straight out the box.
- If the Math library is cloned into a different location, the tests will run once the makefil eknows about the libraries. The simple way to do this is to tell the makefile where Stan exists because it has a copy of the libraries: STANAPI_HOME. If you wanted to set up custom boost, eigen, or gtest, set the EIGEN, BOOST, or GTEST variables.


Questions:
- do we want the Math library to have its own dependent libraries?
- do we want to remove the libraries from Stan if we do?



Daniel


On Wed, Jul 22, 2015 at 12:15 PM, Michael Betancourt <betan...@gmail.com> wrote:
So the math library requires boost, but boost is not included
— shouldn’t boost and eigen and gtest be libraries included
in math and then stan and the interfaces get access to them
via their inclusion of the math library?

Anyways, what’s the procedure for running unit tests on the
math library?  I gots math to update!

--

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Stan Math and its dependent libraries
parts: > - do we want the Math library to have its own dependent libraries?
I think so — Eigen and boost and gtest.
> - do we want to remove the libraries from Stan if we do?

I also think so. That way the dependences are a clear
tree —

math depends on Eigen, boost, and gtest and can be run
independently as its own math library.

stan depends only on math.

The interfaces depend only on stan.
